company.name: Hubble Network
company.shortDescription: Hubble Network is a developer of a satellite-powered Bluetooth network that enables devices to connect regardless of cellular reception.
company.description: Hubble Network offers a platform that enables device tracking and data transmission using Bluetooth chips, without requiring additional infrastructure or custom hardware. It delivers a terrestrial network of tens of millions of access points that cover indoor, urban, and in-transit environments, with plans to expand via satellite to reach remote locations. It provides visibility into asset location and condition for a variety of use cases, including cold chain monitoring, rental equipment recovery, warehouse and yard operations, secure item movement, and intermodal logistics. Integration is supported via APIs and SDKs, and data is encrypted end-to-end using AES. The system works with existing off-the-shelf Bluetooth chips, avoiding hardware lock-in.

aiResearchSummary.text: Hubble Network is researching methods for connecting Bluetooth-enabled devices via satellite networks, focusing on location determination using angle-of-arrival and time-of-flight, communication with multiple satellite networks, and position determination using antenna arrays. Their work includes multi spoke beamforming for low power wide area satellite and terrestrial communication, enabling endpoint devices to communicate and be located even without cellular reception.
